_comment: Work that is merged on main but was NEVER applied to production, and that now sits
BEHIND the deploy marker because a stripped ZIP was applied and HEAD was marked.
`git diff marker..HEAD` can therefore never include it again: a cumulative package
silently omits it. Check-FrozenLots.ps1 warns about every entry still behind the
marker so the omission is stated out loud at packaging time.
REMOVE an entry once its files have been packaged by hand and confirmed in prod.

lots.why: Applied ZIPs were stripped of tools/installer, _sdp_admin.cmd and tools/pg/dump-db.js while the marker moved to 7fd553d. The installer safety screens (red confirmation, pre-restore point, dump completeness check) are NOT in prod. Package by hand after the TEST-instance E2E.

Deliberately frozen until the monthly reporting cycle ends: recolouring decks mid-cycle would break the comparisons. Behind the marker, so a cumulative ZIP will not carry it — package the three files by hand at unfreeze.
